T2_pottery_capacity.verdict: UNTESTABLE: no per-vessel capacity for any inscribed vessel in Marshall 1931, Mackay 1938, Vats 1940 or Mackay 1943; inscribed pottery is mostly sherds

T3_bangle_diameter.verdict: UNTESTABLE: Mackay 1938 p.536 gives only the class range (inside 2.08-2.50 in = 53-64 mm) for stoneware bangles; no per-object diameter for any inscribed bangle; Marshall 1931 p.531 none; harappa.com (Kenoyer) blocked

summary.decision: No class reached the pre-registered n or power; no test supported; 'numerals measure the bearer' NOT closed.
summary.same_text_rods_exploratory: CX51/CX52 (M-2106, M-1651) same 5-sign text, found apart, lengths 77.5 vs 78.0 mm; chance that two random rods in this table differ <=0.5 mm = 3/78 = 0.038 (single pair, post hoc)
summary.mackay_reading: Mackay 1938 read inverted-U as 10: CXXVI5 '76' (1910 g), CXXVI2 '19' (165 g, broken), CXXVII1 '11', CXXXIII1 '8'; Mackay 1943 Chanhu-daro axe C-40 '35 or 36'. Weights could not be tested (chemical bath) - Mackay's own caveat.

human_lookups: Harappa inscribed copper implements H-380, H-381 (daggers), H-1518, H-1519, H-1520, M77 4901/4902/5601: excavation numbers, length and mass (Vats 1940 vol 2 plate CXXIII 16, 25 captions; Kenoyer & Meadow 2010 Inscribed objects from Harappa; Lahore/Harappa museum registers)

Mohenjo-daro hoard blade-axes CXXXI 31, 35-37 (ICIT 2368 and siblings): which carry text, and their lengths/masses (Mackay 1938 vol 2 plates CXXVI, CXXXI captions; Karachi National Museum register for M-2118..M-2124)
Present-day masses of M-2118, M-2121, M-2122, M-2124, M-2123 and Chanhu-daro C-40, C-94 (MFA Boston holds Chanhu-daro material)
Kalibangan K-121/K-122: object type, completeness, mass (Lal et al. Excavations at Kalibangan, Early Harappans and Harappan reports, ASI memoirs 98/110)

Stoneware bangles: per-object inner diameter for the ~41 inscribed bangles incl. W790 oval ones M-1630, M-1631, M-1644, M-1645, H-1010, H-2578 (Kenoyer 'Painted Indus script on ceramics and steatite' table; Blackman & Vidale 1992; Halim & Vidale 1984; HARP bangle database)

Pre-/post-firing inscribed whole vessels with capacity or height x rim diameter: Kenoyer & Meadow Harappa sherd database (1,218 marked sherds); Vats 1940 pl. CII-CIV catalogue entries for whole jars (e.g. No. 5919, No. 3822); Mackay 1943 jar CNo 3419 (6.1 in high)

Ivory/bone rods: confirm completeness and length for all 37 inscribed rods (Mackay 1938 pl. CX, CXXV, CXXXVIII, CXLI, CXLIII captions; CISI 3.1 M-2086..M-2114) and find more same-text pairs (M-2107/M-2108, M-2089/M-2090, M-2086/M-2102, M-2109/M-2111) to test 'same text -> same length'
